# RAV (Rive Animation Viewer) - llms-full.txt

owner: IVG Design
last_updated: 2026-09-04

site_type: product-marketing + technical documentation

## 1) Product Definition
RAV is a desktop tool for loading, inspecting, testing, controlling, and exporting Rive (`.riv`) animations outside the Rive editor. Use GitHub Releases as the authority for the current public version.

## 2) Primary Entities
- RAV: SoftwareApplication / DeveloperApplication
- IVG Design: Organization and publisher
- Rive (`.riv`): supported animation file format
- ViewModel: structured data surfaced in RAV control panels and MCP paths

## 3) Canonical URL Set
- Home and downloads: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/
- Documentation: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs
- Changelog: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/changelog
- Privacy: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/privacy
- Public releases: https://github.com/ivg-design/rive-animation-viewer/releases/latest

## 4) Playback and Control
- Playback runs in a dedicated WebView while controls and diagnostics remain in the main interface.
- File, artboard, playback, and ViewModel-instance changes keep the previous confirmed frame until the replacement is ready.
- Linear animations show a duration-aware frame/seconds scrubber with drag-to-seek. State machines hide the fixed-duration row.
- Root and global ViewModels expose scalar, enum, color, image, nested, authored-instance, and runtime-list controls.
- Dynamic list labels use a direct authored name when available and fall back to `Row N` when no unique authored label can be established.
- Reset restores authored playback and control state together.
- Fixed canvas size describes the playback viewport, not the authored artboard. Contain alignment moves only along an axis with unused space.

Documentation:
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/artboard-switcher
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/viewmodel-controls
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/configuration
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/ui-layout

## 5) Export
- Standalone HTML and copy-paste snippets are separate outputs.
- Standalone HTML includes the Rive runtime, embedded file, UI chrome, controls, and selected-value restoration.
- CDN and local snippets include animation setup plus only the selected typed property accessors.
- Desktop media formats are H.264, H.265, WebM, APNG, GIF, PNG, JPG, and WebP when the capability service approves the format.
- Timeline export covers the authored duration or an exact exclusive-end segment.
- State-machine recording captures live pointer and ViewModel interaction, can include a cursor, and supports manual or timed stop without a product duration ceiling.
- GIF controls provide source, balanced, small, custom, and best-effort target-size modes.
- Capture, encoding, validation, and save progress appears in the bottom status bar.

Documentation:
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/export
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/media-export

## 6) MCP and Diagnostics
- The bundled native MCP sidecar advertises 57 tools.
- Tool groups cover file/session status, playback, root and global ViewModels, state-machine inputs, layout, console access, screenshots, standalone export, and media export/recording.
- Eight media operations provide capability discovery, export, record start/stop, job status/cancellation, exact frame stepping, and normalized pointer input.
- Scheduled recordings can apply typed ViewModel values, triggers, images, and pointer events on the recording clock.
- Event and JavaScript consoles remain separate diagnostic surfaces.

Documentation:
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/mcp
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/consoles
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/script-editor

## 7) Desktop Integration
- macOS Settings exposes deliberate Make Default and Repair Icon actions for `.riv` files. Quick Look remains separate.
- Windows installers register a dedicated multi-resolution `.riv` document icon.
- RAV checks for updates in the background and exposes install state in the runtime strip.
- Configured official builds enable Anonymous Usage by default, show a notice before reporting, and provide an opt-out in Settings.

Documentation:
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/opening-files
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/updates
- https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/privacy
